title: NexuAlpha Academy Hyperframes Level 4 local scene timing
description: Editable timing.json for copied script.json scenes. The canonical roundtrip shape uses duration and words; seconds is accepted as an authoring alias for duration before the loader rounds to 30fps frames.

id.description: Exact generated scene id matching the 1-based scene order in script.json.

duration.description: Canonical local scene duration in seconds. The loader requires this to be at least the scene min_s and rounded to a 30fps frame boundary after normalization.

seconds.description: Authoring alias for duration in seconds. If duration is also present, both values must match.

words.description: Optional preserved per-word timeline. Omit to let the loader estimate words from voice_zh, ending before the 0.4s caption-free tail.
